requirements.quote: A NOTIFICATION message is sent when an error condition is detected.
requirements.condition: An error condition is detected.
requirements.required_behavior: Send a NOTIFICATION message.
requirements.why_checkable: Error processing can be checked for generation of a NOTIFICATION.

requirements.quote:
A NOTIFICATION message is sent when an error condition is detected.
   The BGP connection is closed immediately after it is sent.
requirements.condition: A NOTIFICATION message has been sent.
requirements.required_behavior: Close the BGP connection immediately after sending the NOTIFICATION.
requirements.error_behavior: Immediately close the BGP connection after sending the NOTIFICATION.
requirements.why_checkable: The send and connection-close sequence can be observed.

requirements.condition: Encoding a NOTIFICATION message.
requirements.required_behavior: Place Error Code, then Error Subcode, then variable-length Data after the fixed-size BGP header.
requirements.why_checkable: The field encoding can be inspected and checked against serialized messages.

         information about the nature of the reported error.  Each Error
         Code may have one or more Error Subcodes associated with it.

         the NOTIFICATION.  The contents of the Data field depend upon
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding a NOTIFICATION Data field.
requirements.required_behavior: Support a variable-length Data field used to diagnose the reason for the NOTIFICATION.
requirements.why_checkable: The field encoding can be inspected and checked against serialized messages.

requirements.quote:
the NOTIFICATION.  The contents of the Data field depend upon
         the Error Code and Error Subcode.  See Section 6 for more
         details.
requirements.condition: Selecting NOTIFICATION Data field contents.
requirements.required_behavior: Select Data field contents according to Error Code and Error Subcode, with details specified in Section 6.
requirements.why_checkable: The dependency is explicit, but this chunk does not supply the code-specific Data formats.

requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding a NOTIFICATION message.
requirements.required_behavior: Require Message Length to equal 21 plus Data Length.
requirements.why_checkable: The header length and actual Data length can be compared.

requirements.quote:
The minimum length of the NOTIFICATION message is 21 octets
   (including message header).
requirements.condition: Encoding or decoding a NOTIFICATION message.
requirements.required_behavior: Require total message length, including the header, to be at least 21 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The minimum message-length boundary is directly testable.
